newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch PTT to extend billing per second.
newsitem.headline: Dutch PTT to extend billing per second.

text.p: Dutch post and telecoms group PTT Nederland NV said on Wednesday it will introduce per second billing (PSB) on ordinary lines in the first half of 1997.
PTT currently uses PSB for ISDN and mobile calls and billing based on call units for ordinary lines.

PSB consists of a call answering charge, independent of destination and time of the day, payable only if the call is answered, and a price for each second that a call lasts, depending on destination and time of day.
PTT will launch new subscription packages detailing prices and services. Among other things, there will be packages for light users and for heavy users.
